label: literal-pandas-datetimeindex-bar
code:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


n["week"]=n.date.dt.to_period("W-SUN").dt.start_time
weekly=n.pivot_table(index="week",columns="shop_id",values="neg",aggfunc="mean")
a=n.assign(month=n.date.dt.month).pivot_table(index="shop_id",columns="month",values="neg",aggfunc="mean")
focus_shop=(a[10]-a[9]).idxmax()
jump_week=weekly[focus_shop].diff().idxmax()
sept_max=round(float(weekly.loc[weekly.index<jump_week,focus_shop].max()),3)
ax=weekly[focus_shop].plot(kind="bar");ax.set(title="Доля сигналов "+focus_shop,xlabel="Понедельник недели",ylabel="Доля отзывов");plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
print(focus_shop,jump_week,n.groupby(["shop_id","week"]).size().loc[focus_shop].to_dict())
description: Буквальный код ученика; правильный график. Pyodide renderer может упасть до check: отдельно считать stage/error, не ложным отказом guard.

label: explicit-categorical-bar
code:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


n["week"]=n.date.dt.to_period("W-SUN").dt.start_time
weekly=n.pivot_table(index="week",columns="shop_id",values="neg",aggfunc="mean")
a=n.assign(month=n.date.dt.month).pivot_table(index="shop_id",columns="month",values="neg",aggfunc="mean")
focus_shop=(a[10]-a[9]).idxmax()
jump_week=weekly[focus_shop].diff().idxmax()
sept_max=round(float(weekly.loc[weekly.index<jump_week,focus_shop].max()),3)
import numpy as np
fig,ax=plt.subplots()
positions=np.arange(len(weekly))
ax.bar(positions,weekly[focus_shop].to_numpy(),label=focus_shop)
labels=[date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d') for date in weekly.index]
ax.set_xticks(positions,labels)
ax.set(title=str(focus_shop),ylabel='Доля сигналов')
description: Центры0..8, реальные календарные даты в ticklabels, высоты по соответствующей неделе

label: direct-datetime-matplotlib-bar
code:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


n["week"]=n.date.dt.to_period("W-SUN").dt.start_time
weekly=n.pivot_table(index="week",columns="shop_id",values="neg",aggfunc="mean")
a=n.assign(month=n.date.dt.month).pivot_table(index="shop_id",columns="month",values="neg",aggfunc="mean")
focus_shop=(a[10]-a[9]).idxmax()
jump_week=weekly[focus_shop].diff().idxmax()
sept_max=round(float(weekly.loc[weekly.index<jump_week,focus_shop].max()),3)
fig,ax=plt.subplots();ax.bar(weekly.index.to_pydatetime(),weekly[focus_shop].to_numpy(),width=4);ax.set(title="Доля сигналов "+focus_shop,xlabel="Понедельник недели",ylabel="Доля отзывов");plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
print(focus_shop,jump_week,n.groupby(["shop_id","week"]).size().loc[focus_shop].to_dict())
